title: Exact five-original-point deterministic B/A charge polynomial
statement: For s=2^h>=2 and arbitrary complete right g and left f global injections, I_L^(BA,int)(f,g)=sum_{p,A:|A|=4} w_g(p,A)*chi_B(f(p),f(A)), with w_g counting actual original six-incidence Q sharing exactly five genuine original point factor IDs, nonnegative integer coefficients and one globally coherent pair of maps.

quantifiers.domain: any complete original globally injected right-line map
any complete original globally injected left-point map

external_dependencies: True original positional GF5 B/A classifier with physical C4 and disjoint root physical pair.
limitations: Nonnegative quintic representation need not have a uniform positive minimum.
This is not a degree-two pair-charge lower bound.
Does not settle the root Branch A/B/C.
falsification_boundary: w_g counts genuine original sixset multiplicity and chi_B uses physical simple C4; physical P3 surrogates are invalid.
